title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Error Worksheet: Amount in Dispute on a Duplicate Foreign Posting
content:
**Worksheet rule.** For a notice that a purchase processed in a foreign currency or outside the United States posted twice to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account:

1. **Twin postings.** The notice concerns the purchase posting against which the account's most recently posted foreign transaction fee was assessed (the fee-bearing posting) and the other purchase posting from the same merchant with the same transaction date; together they are the twin postings. When no foreign transaction fee has posted to the account, or the fee-bearing posting has no such twin, there are no twin postings, the notice does not apply and the amount in dispute is zero.
2. **Posting in error.** The posting in error is chosen by comparing the twin postings: when their amounts differ by no more than the card's foreign transaction fee percent of the smaller amount, the posting in error is the larger posting; when their amounts differ by more than that, the posting in error is the smaller posting; when their amounts are equal, the posting in error is the later-posted one.
3. **Related fee.** The foreign transaction fee posted against the posting in error, when one has posted, is the related fee.
4. **Related billed interest.** The related interest base multiplied by the sum of the posting in error and the related fee, divided by the interest-bearing balance, multiplied by the billing-time fraction, rounded half up to the cent; zero when the interest-bearing balance is not above zero. In this worksheet the related interest base is taken as zero, the interest-bearing balance as the latest statement balance and the billing-time fraction as one.
5. **Related unbilled interest.** The posting in error multiplied by the card's daily periodic rate (the card's purchase APR divided by 100 and by the card's days-in-year divisor), multiplied by the accrual days, rounded half up to the cent; the accrual days are taken as zero.
6. **Amount in dispute.** The posting in error plus the related fee, the related billed interest, the related unbilled interest and the related other charge, rounded half up to the cent; the related other charge is taken as zero.

The card's foreign transaction fee percent, purchase APR and days-in-year divisor are the card's figures in the fee schedule and the rates table.

## Worked lines (hypothetical account on a card with a 3 percent foreign transaction fee)

| Line | Content |
|---|---|
| Most recently posted foreign transaction fee | USD 6.00, posted 7 June, assessed against purchase B (the fee-bearing posting) |
| Purchase B | merchant Hotel Lisboa, transaction date 2 June, posted 6 June, USD 200.00 |
| Purchase A | merchant Hotel Lisboa, transaction date 2 June, posted 4 June, USD 205.00 |
| Comparison | the amounts differ by USD 5.00; 3 percent of the smaller is USD 6.00 |
| Posting in error | A, the larger posting |
| Related fee | none has posted against A |
| Amount in dispute | USD 205.00 |

With twins of USD 200.00 and USD 210.00 the difference of USD 10.00 is more than USD 6.00, and the posting in error is the USD 200.00 posting; with equal amounts it is the later-posted one. When the posting in error carries its own foreign transaction fee of USD 6.00, the amount in dispute is the posting plus USD 6.00.
